entities.description: A close-up view of a wooden chessboard with alternating light and dark squares, featuring several chess pieces in the foreground and background. The pieces are made of wood, with the lighter pieces appearing to be a pale, natural wood tone and the darker pieces a rich, dark brown. The board has a wooden frame, and the pieces are arranged in a typical starting position, though not all pieces are visible. The focus is on the center of the board, with the pieces in the foreground slightly out of focus.

pieces.focus: center of the board, foreground pieces slightly out of focus

entities.description: A person with short brown hair is seen from behind, wearing a dark blue suit jacket over a white collared shirt. The individual is seated, facing away from the camera, with the back of their head and shoulders clearly visible.

A person is seen from behind, wearing a dark blue suit jacket, seated at a table with chess pieces in the foreground. The individual's hair is short and dark, and they appear to be engaged in a chess game.

attributes.pose: seated, facing away from the camera

entities.description: A close-up profile of a man with dark curly hair and black-rimmed glasses, wearing a dark blue suit jacket, resting his chin on his hand in a contemplative pose. In the blurred background, the back of another man with short dark hair wearing a similar dark blue suit and white shirt is visible.

A woman with long, dark brown hair is shown out of focus in the background, wearing a black blazer over a white collared shirt and a necklace. She is positioned behind the out-of-focus heads of two other people in the foreground.

A young man with dark curly hair and black-rimmed glasses sits at a chessboard, wearing a dark navy suit jacket over a white collared shirt. He rests his chin on his right hand in a contemplative pose, looking down at the chess pieces in front of him.
